meaning:
δεκατόω, -ῶ,
= cl. -τεύω (δεκάτη), [in LXX: Neh.10:37 (38) (עשׂר pi.) * ;]
to take tithe of: with accusative of person(s), Heb.7:6; pass. to pay tithe: Heb.7:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
